RPT.Title: Traps
RPT.NoGM: A GM must be online to set traps.
RPT.DcTip: Item DC {base} · level DC {level} (per the DC setting)

Pc.Title: Set traps
Pc.Open: Trap-setting is open — set your traps now
Pc.Closed: You can set traps once the GM opens trap-setting
Pc.Secret: Traps set here don't show on the GM's screen
Pc.NoKit: No snares, traps, poisons or caltrops.

KitHint.best: DC: the higher of item DC and level DC{bonus}.
KitHint.item: DC: the item's own (none: level DC{bonus}).

Pc.NonePlaced: None yet. Click 'Set' on the left, then a square on the map.
Pc.PickupHint: Take the trap back into the party's packs
Pc.DoneLine: {name}: the players have set {n} trap(s). (Their locations are secret.)

Gm.Title: Traps — GM
Gm.PhaseOpen: Player trap-setting: open (they're setting traps in secret)
Gm.PeekHint: Show the players' traps on your screen only, for {s} seconds.
Gm.PeekLine: The GM peeked at the trap locations.
Gm.ClearPcHint: Clear every player trap (without looking at them)
Gm.ClearPcAsk: Clear every player trap on this scene? (They don't return to the packs.)
Gm.ClearGmAsk: Clear every GM trap on this scene?
Gm.Drop: Drop an item or a hazard here, or enter a name and a DC.
Gm.Name: Name
Gm.DescHint: e.g. The floor gives way onto spikes. @Check[reflex|dc:20|basic]; on a failure, 2d8 piercing.
Gm.CloseAsk: The players' trap-setting is still open. Close it along with this window?
Gm.CloseAskKeep: Keep it open, just close the window

Place.Hint: Click a square to place the trap (right-click / Esc: cancel)
Place.NoGrid: Traps need a scene with a grid.
Place.Taken: There is a trap on that square already.

Phase.Open: The GM opened trap-setting — set your traps in secret.
Phase.GmOpen: Player trap-setting is open. Their traps don't show on your screen.

Pop.Title: Trap sprung — {name}
Pop.RearmHint: Undo — arm the trap again as if nothing happened

Settings.DcModeHint: The level DC uses the level of whoever sets or carries it.
Settings.DcBest: The higher of item DC and level DC
Settings.PhaseHint: On: players can set traps only while the GM has trap-setting open.
Settings.PcHitsHint: Players' side: player-owned, party members, PF2e party alliance, friendly.
Settings.Enemies: Anyone not on the players' side
Settings.GmHitsHint: Players' side: player-owned, party members, PF2e party alliance, friendly.
Settings.PeekSecondsHint: How long player traps show on your screen.
Settings.PeekNoticeHint: On: posts a chat line when the GM peeks at the players' traps.
Settings.MarkersHint: (Players) Show your party's traps on the map.
Settings.PlayerToolHint: Always show the Set traps button. Off (default): only during trap-setting.
Settings.PoisonTune: Tune the PCs' poisons to their level
Settings.PoisonTuneHint: Poisons in PC packs use the trap DC rule (damage unchanged).
Settings.PoisonHalf: Half stage 1 damage on a successful save
Settings.PoisonHalfHint: Adds that line to the poison's description.
Settings.PoisonCoat: Coated weapons poison on a hit
Settings.PoisonCoatHint: Injury poisons go on a chosen weapon; its next hit delivers them.
Settings.MenuHint: All of this module's settings in one window.

RPT.Passed: {name} crossed “{trap}”; it didn't go off (GM traps catch: {who}).

Coat.Title: Apply poison
Coat.Rule: If this weapon's next Strike before the end of your next turn hits, the poison takes effect. A critical failure wastes it.
Coat.Dried: {weapon}: {poison} dried at the end of the next turn.
Coat.NoTarget: {poison}: target a creature before the Strike. The poison is still on the weapon.
